title: Platform Change at the Station
gist_ar: إعلان في محطة القطر إن قطر الأقصر غيّر الرصيف وهيتأخر شوية، وتعليمات للناس.

before_listening.en: You are in a train station. Two announcements will play. Listen for the ONE thing every passenger must do.
before_listening.ar: إنت في محطة قطر. هتسمع إعلانين. ركّز على الحاجة الوحيدة اللي كل مسافر لازم يعملها.

segments.speaker: Announcer
segments.text: Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen. This is an announcement for passengers travelling to Luxor. The two o'clock train has changed platform. It will now leave from platform five, not platform two. The train left the depot late this morning, so it will depart about fifteen minutes behind time. We are sorry for the delay.

segments.speaker: Station staff
segments.text: If you already went to platform two, please come back to the main hall and take the stairs on your left. Passengers with heavy bags can use the lift next to the ticket office. Please keep your ticket in your hand, because staff will check tickets at the gate today.

gist_question.q: What is the main message of these announcements?
options: The train to Luxor is cancelled today
The Luxor train now leaves from a different platform, a little late
Passengers to Luxor must buy a new ticket

questions.q: Which platform does the Luxor train leave from now?
questions.q_ar: قطر الأقصر هيقوم من رصيف نمرة كام دلوقتي؟

questions.q: How late will the train be?
What should passengers with heavy bags do?
questions.q_ar: اللي معاهم شنط تقيلة يعملوا إيه؟
options: Take the stairs on the left
Use the lift near the ticket office
